members.condition: when the server requested certificate-based client authentication and the client authenticates with a certificate
members.required_behavior: send the client CertificateVerify message
members.forbidden_behavior: omit the requested client CertificateVerify message
members.why_checkable: A handshake trace can check CertificateVerify presence after the requested client Certificate.

evidence.quote:
namely Certificate and CertificateVerify (if
   requested), and Finished.

members.condition: a client authenticates via a non-empty Certificate message
members.required_behavior: send CertificateVerify
members.why_checkable: A non-empty client Certificate can be correlated with the following messages.

evidence.quote:
Clients MUST send this message whenever
authenticating via a certificate (i.e., when the Certificate message
is non-empty).

supporting_links.reason: Both require a client that authenticates with a non-empty Certificate to send CertificateVerify; the canonical evidence is the direct normative MUST in the primary CertificateVerify section.
